description: Lists the spaces the authenticated user is a member of: name (spaces/<id>), displayName (empty for direct messages), spaceType (SPACE = named room, GROUP_CHAT, DIRECT_MESSAGE), spaceThreadingState and timestamps. This is the discovery entry point — space names from here feed every other tool. space_type narrows the listing server-side; there is no text search here — match displayName client-side, or use search_spaces (Workspace admin only). Paginate with page_token from nextPageToken; results are unordered.

space_type.description: Only spaces of this type: space (named room), group_chat, or direct_message.
